sloka: शेषं च हविषस्तस्य प्राश्याशास्यात्मनः प्रियम् ।ध्यायन्नारायणं देवं स्वास्तीर्णे कुशसंस्तरे ॥२-६-३॥
transliteration: śeṣaṁ ca haviṣastasya prāśyāśāsyātmanaḥ priyam ।dhyāyannārāyaṇaṁ devaṁ svāstīrṇe kuśasaṁstare ॥2-6-3॥

translations.english: The son of the king (Rama) partook the remainder of the havis seeking his own welfare. With a restrained mind and a vow of silence, he meditated upon Lord Narayana and slept along with Vaidehi on a wellspread bed of kusha grass in the auspicious temple of lord Visnu.
